names: International Day for the Eradication of Poverty

events.text: General Burgoyne surrenders at Saratoga in the American Revolutionary War.
Gangster Al Capone is convicted of tax evasion.
Albert Einstein arrives in the United States as a refugee from Nazi Germany.
Calder Hall in England, the first commercial nuclear power station, opens.
Arab oil producers begin an oil embargo against the United States.
The Loma Prieta earthquake strikes the San Francisco Bay Area.
